 Find Your Adventure On Our Cave Point Extended Tour!
Kayakers of all experience levels are welcome on this extended tour!

After launching the kayaks at Schauer park guests will kayak to Cave Point and then on to view Whitefish Bay Dunes State Park(wind and wave dependent). On the return from Whitefish Bay Dunes, we stop at Cave Point County Park where we setup a locally sourced picnic.  You can cliff jump into Devils Bathtub(when water height is appropriate) and have your experience captured by one of our trained photographers for an instagram shot. Kayaking along the caves and coves is a once in a lifetime experience and offers an exclusive look into the vistas that can only be seen from the water.

Pictures can hardly do justice to the sights and sounds you will experience while paddling around these geologic wonders.

 Book Now

 Whitefish Dunes State Park

 Following our visit to Cave Point, we view Whitefish Dunes State Park from the kayaks. The view offers beautiful expanses of beach and the marvelous sand formations known as the Dunes.

 Light Picnic

 This appetizer style lunch won’t leave you too full but offers a taste of our favorite local foods that will surely lead to a shopping trip on your way home from the tour.

Light picnic includes: Local Door County Creamery Chevre(when available), Crackers, Dried cherries, and local pickled items.

 Cliff Jumping

 When warm enough and calm enough, cliff jumping is a fun activity to take part of.  Make sure you jump shallow, as the water is not significantly deep to afford diving.

 Boat Seating possibilities

 Where We Meet

We meet you at our location inside Cave Point Paddle & Pedal (6329 Highway 57 in Sturgeon Bay, WI 54235)

Please arrive 20 minutes before your scheduled tour time!

 What You Should Bring

Water

Light layered synthetic clothing /  Swimsuit

Hat

Sunglasses

 Optional Add-Ons

Bottled water ($1/ea.)

Paddling glove rental ($5/pair)

Waterproof phone case ($10/ea.)

Photography package ($20/person) — Nothing solidifies memories quite like photographs. A land-based professional photographer captures your experience! Your photographs are available for digital download on dcphotofun.com within 24 hours of your tour, and if your photographs aren’t delivered for any reason, you are issued a refund.
